name: Stark Future
desc: Designs, manufactures and sells electric off-road motorcycles, building them in its own factory near Barcelona.
capacity_detail: Raised more than EUR 150M at a EUR 1.2B valuation, led by Highland Europe (Nov 2026)
markets: Sells electric off-road motorcycles in a global market it puts at EUR 3 billion, holding about 5%; new capital for global expansion.

signals.raise: Raised more than EUR 150M at EUR 1.2B valuation led by Highland Europe, with Morgan Stanley IM 1GT and Axon Partners (Nov 2026; https://tech.eu/2026/11/16/barcelona-based-stark-future-motors-to-unicorn-status/)

rationale: Performance electric motorcycle brand born in enduro racing; F1 fans are motorsport enthusiasts and its first unicorn round funds global expansion.

name: Onodrim Industries
desc: European platform that acquires controlling stakes in defence, aerospace and industrial supply-chain businesses with permanent capital.
capacity_detail: USD 300M Series A at a USD 1.3B valuation, led by Lux Capital (Nov 2026)
markets: Europe: offices in Amsterdam, London, Vilnius, Munich and Turin; focus on aerospace, defence and industrial manufacturing.

signals.raise: USD 300M Series A at USD 1.3B valuation led by Lux Capital with General Catalyst, Lakestar, Altimeter (Nov 2026; https://tech.eu/2026/11/09/onodrim-industries-hits-13b-valuation-with-300m-series-a-to-strengthen-european-defence/)

rationale: Newly funded defence roll-up building an industrial group; F1 engineering hospitality could support recruiting and B2B relationships, though defence limits consumer branding.

name: EOS-X Space
desc: Spanish company operating five-hour helium balloon capsule flights to about 40 km altitude for paying passengers.
capacity_detail: USD 120M round led by Global Emerging Markets at a USD 1.2B pre-commercial valuation (Nov 2026); USD 260M raised in 2026
markets: Luxury near-space flights at about USD 200,000 per flight; launch site planned in Seville; bought Florida-based Space Perspective's capsule business.

signals.raise: USD 120M led by GEM at USD 1.2B valuation (Nov 2026; https://techfundingnews.com/eos-x-space-110m-raise-1-2b-valuation-balloon-flights/)

rationale: Ultra-luxury experience brand selling to high-net-worth customers; F1 Paddock Club audiences match its buyer profile ahead of first commercial flights.

name: Corma
desc: Builds AI foundation models and autonomous agents that detect, investigate and handle cyber threats for enterprises.
capacity_detail: USD 125M Series A at a USD 1B valuation led by NEA (Nov 2026); USD 185M raised in total
markets: Enterprise customers and prospects across the Fortune 100, Fortune 500 and Global 500; offices in Tel Aviv and San Francisco.

signals.raise: USD 125M Series A at USD 1B valuation led by NEA, with Sequoia, Khosla, Coatue (Nov 2026; https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/rq8lzbs4c)

rationale: Cybersecurity rivals such as CrowdStrike, Zscaler and Cato Networks already use F1 to reach enterprise buyers; a new unicorn needs brand awareness fast.

name: Ramon.Space
desc: Builds computing systems that let satellites process, store and transmit data in orbit using AI processors.
capacity_detail: USD 124M Series B led by PSG with Micron (Nov 2026); about USD 180M raised in total
markets: Satellite operators and Earth observation providers, commercial and government; staff in Israel, US, UK, Germany; Crunchbase lists HQ as Denver.

signals.raise: USD 124M Series B led by PSG, strategic investment from Micron (Nov 2026; https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/ryr9t6tcgl)

rationale: Deep-tech B2B supplier with a niche customer base; F1 would mainly serve engineering recruitment and hospitality rather than brand reach.

name: Ziehl-Abegg
desc: German manufacturer of fans and integrated motors for HVAC, industrial cooling and data-centre thermal management.
ownership: private, owner not stated; ABB agreed to acquire it (closing expected second half 2027)
capacity_detail: ABB agreed to buy it for USD 2.22B in an all-equity deal (Nov 2026); revenue expected about USD 1.4B in 2026
markets: Fans and motors for HVAC, industrial cooling and data centres; German maker with a Winston-Salem, North Carolina presence.
rationale: Pending sale to ABB makes near-term independent sponsorship unlikely, but its cooling technology story suits F1 engineering B2B hospitality.

name: Desotec
desc: European environmental service company based in Roeselare, Belgium, majority-acquired by EQT from Blackstone in 2025.
ownership: private equity: EQT (majority), Blackstone (minority), with Athos and Merckle family offices co-investing
capacity_detail: EQT agreed to buy a majority stake from Blackstone in a deal valuing it at about EUR 2B (USD 2.3B) including debt (Nov 2025)
markets: Environmental services for industrial customers in Europe; headquartered in Roeselare, Belgium.
rationale: Private-equity-owned industrial services group could use F1 sustainability and B2B hospitality platforms, though its consumer brand profile is low.

name: Tiberius Aerospace
desc: Develops precision-guided 155mm artillery munitions and AI-powered software to speed up and cheapen missile manufacturing.
capacity_detail: USD 85M Series A led by Lakestar and Rochefort Asset Management at a valuation of more than USD 1bn (Nov 2026)
markets: Licenses its munitions systems to allied nations that build them locally; offices in the US and UK.

signals.raise: USD 85M Series A at more than USD 1bn valuation led by Lakestar and Rochefort (Nov 2026; https://tech.eu/2026/11/17/tiberius-aerospace-with-strong-uk-links-raises-85-million/)

rationale: Weapons maker selling to governments; sponsorship would be restricted and brand-sensitive, so F1 fit is limited to engineering recruitment.

name: Stahl
desc: Dutch maker of specialty coatings and leather finishing for packaging, automotive, fashion and lifestyle products.
ownership: subsidiary of Wendel (68.5%), with BASF (16.1%) and Clariant (14.6%); Henkel agreed to acquire the majority stake
capacity_detail: Henkel agreed to acquire a majority stake from Wendel in a EUR 2.1bn (USD 2.48bn) deal (Feb 2026); adjusted sales about EUR 725m in FY2025
markets: Coatings for packaging, automotive interiors, fashion and lifestyle goods; leather finishing, performance coatings and paper packaging graphics.
rationale: Automotive interior coatings supplier; F1 technical partnership could showcase materials to car-maker customers, though pending Henkel ownership may absorb marketing.

name: Signal AI
desc: AI platform analysing billions of data points to identify emerging risks and reputation threats for corporate clients.
ownership: private, owner not stated; Battery Ventures took a major stake
capacity_detail: USD 165m (GBP 122m) growth equity round led by Battery Ventures (Sep 2025), after about USD 100m raised earlier
markets: More than 650 clients including Bloomberg, Uber and Diageo; London-based with global corporate customers.
rationale: B2B intelligence brand courting global corporates; F1 hospitality offers access to C-suite buyers, though its GBP 23m revenue limits budget.
